title: Platinum Reserve Account: Managing authorized users
summary: This document explains how to manage authorized users for a Platinum Reserve Account, including defining initiator/approver/viewer roles using segregation-of-duties, adding/removing users via administrative settings, and keeping permissions scoped. It sets a maximum of 10 authorized users and covers periodic access reviews, high-privilege attestations, and using activity logs to verify approvals and sensitive actions.
faqs: How do I assign initiator, approver, and viewer roles for a Platinum Reserve Account (segregation of duties)?
Where do I add authorized users, and how are roles assigned during onboarding?
What is the maximum number of authorized users allowed on a Platinum Reserve Account?
When and how should I remove an authorized user when responsibilities change or they leave?
How do I prevent privilege creep when roles or permissions change?
What oversight steps (access reviews, attestations, activity logs) are required for authorized user management?
